applies_to: CX4250n and CX4280n (backplane NAS; separately packaged kit, in addition to SBAG-HWKIT).
note: Same kit name and screw counts as the CX4712/CX4713 kit (products/shared/CX-NAS-HWKIT.json); the backplane replaces the SAS/SATA adapters and SATA power splitters, and the kit adds the three backplane power cables (confirmed 2026-11-20).

items.name: HDD shoulder screws (217-735)
items.description: Four per 3.5-inch HDD; they guide the drive into its hot-swap bay.

items.name: Thumb screws (217-737)
items.note: Illustrated with the 217-736 render, which differs only in thread length (confirmed 2026-11-04).

items.name: Backplane power cables
items.description: One dual 4-pin to EPS cable and two single 4-pin to 6-pin PCIe cables, from the PSU to the backplane.

items.name: Key pair
items.description: Locks and unlocks the drive retention tray.
